In May 1980, Mt. St. Helens famously erupted leaving a massive crater and massive destruction behind. Flying above this mountain is a once in a lifetime experience and we're pleased to offer this extremely unique airplane flight. 

Fly with Envi Adventures on the Volcano air tour s the most convenient scenic flight option in Portland, we offer daily flights up and around Mount Saint Helens for groups up to five for the absolute best views of this iconic PNW volcano.

This Pacific Northwest air tour is an epic experience and the most incredible way to get up close to the crater and blast zone of Mount St. Helens.
